blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
LLM personalization aims to generate responses aligned with individual users’ preferences and needs.
User-specific rubrics make these expectations explicit, providing direct supervision on what a satisfactory answer should cover.
Existing rubric-guided approaches, however, exploit such guidance only at a coarse granularity, either by using rubrics to supervise the prediction of relevant aspects for subsequent generation or by reducing aspect coverage to a single response-level reward for reinforcement learning.
This leaves a gap between specifying what a personalized answer should contain and teaching the model how to generate it.
To bridge this gap, we propose GRASP , a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM personalization that turns user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained, token-level supervision.
Specifically, GRASP pairs a rubric-free student with a rubric-informed teacher that additionally receives the target user-specific rubrics.
By aligning their next-token distributions along on-policy trajectories generated by the student, GRASP transfers the teacher’s rubric-conditioned guidance into the student, translating user-specific semantic requirements into dense token-level supervision.
Since rubric-informed teachers can still produce inadequate supervision, we further introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which retains only instances where the teacher sufficiently covers the target aspects, improving both supervision quality and training efficiency.
Experiments on the LaMP-QA benchmark for personalized question answering demonstrate that GRASP achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple backbones, supporting the effectiveness of rubric-guided token-level supervision for personalization.
blocks.zh:
LLM个性化旨在生成与个人用户的偏好和需求一致的响应.
用户特有的标题明确了这些期望,直接监督满意的答案应涵盖哪些内容。
但是,现有的标题制导方法只在粗粒性时才利用这种制导方法,要么使用标题来监督对相关方面的预测,供以后生成,要么将侧面覆盖范围缩小到加强学习的单一响应级奖励。
这就在具体说明一个个性化的答案应该包含什么和教导模型如何生成之间留下了空白.
为了弥补这一差距,我们提出巨猿生存方案(GRASP),这是一个关于LLM个性化的具有政策意识的自我消化框架,它将用户特有的主题方面转化为精细的、象征性的监督。
具体地说,巨猿生存方案将一名无标记的学生与一名有标记知识的教师配对,后者额外接收目标用户专用的标记。
GRASP根据学生所创造的政策轨迹, 将老师的标语指导转移到学生身上,
由于基于名义知识的教师仍能产生不充分的监督,我们进一步采用了基于Rubric的教师鉴定(RTV),这只保留了教师充分涵盖目标方面的情况,提高了监督质量和培训效率。
关于个性化问答的LAMP-QA基准的实验表明,巨猿生存方案实现了跨越多个骨干骨干的最先进的性能,支持了robrique-guide-sorder-level监管个人化的有效性.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
As large language models (LLMs) ( Achiam et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026a ) become increasingly capable, their expanding use in information seeking and decision support has heightened the need to serve users with diverse preferences and needs ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) .
This growing use motivates LLM personalization , which moves beyond “one-size-fits-all” responses to accommodate differences among users ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Qiu et al., 2025b ) .
This need is particularly salient in question answering, where users asking the same question may seek different information, motivating personalized question answering (PQA) ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
随着大型语言模型(LLMs)(Achiam等人,2023年;Guo等人,2025年;Yang等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年a)的能力日益增强,在信息搜索和决策支持中不断扩大的使用,更加需要为有不同偏好和需要的用户服务(Salemi等人,2024年;赵等人,2025年;张等人,2026年c).
这种不断增长的使用促使LLM个性化,它超越了“一刀切”的对策,以适应用户之间的差异(Zhang等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年;Quu等人,2025年b)。
这种需要在回答问题时尤其突出,询问同一问题的用户可能寻求不同的信息,激发个性化回答(PQA)(Salemi和Zamani,2025年)。

blocks.en:
What makes a personalized answer good is not merely factual correctness, but whether it covers the aspects that matter to this particular user ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
Two users asking the same question may prioritize entirely different things: one may favor conventional choices, whereas another may seek novelty, so an answer that is accurate yet addresses the wrong aspects helps neither.
These expectations are increasingly formalized as user-specific rubrics , whose constituent aspects specify what a satisfactory personalized answer should cover ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) .
The central challenge is therefore to translate these rubric-defined requirements into effective guidance for generating answers that address the user’s specific needs.
blocks.zh:
使个性化的答案好起来的不仅仅是事实正确性,而是它是否涵盖了这个特定使用者所关心的方面(邱等人,2026年;陈等人,2026年).
问同一问题的两个用户可能会把完全不同的事情放在优先位置:一个可能倾向于常规选择,而另一个可能寻求新颖性,因此,一个准确但解决错误方面问题的答案也无济于事。
这些期望日益正式化,成为用户特有的主题,其组成方面规定了令人满意的个性化答案应涵盖哪些内容(Salemi和Zamani,2025年)。
因此,主要的挑战是如何将这些界定的要点的要求转化为有效的指导,以产生满足用户具体需要的答案。

blocks.en:
Yet existing rubric-guided personalization methods offer limited guidance on how to realize these requirements during generation.
PlanPers ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) trains a separate planner to predict relevant rubric aspects and conditions answer generation on the resulting plan, but rubric supervision targets the planner rather than the generator, and planning errors can affect the final response.
IAP ( Amirizaniani et al., 2026 ) instead converts aspect coverage into a scalar reward and optimizes it with reinforcement learning, but such a reward is sparse, providing limited feedback on which token-level decisions contribute to satisfying individual aspects.
Consequently, existing methods exploit rich, user-specific rubric aspects only through coarse supervision, leaving their potential for fine-grained token-level guidance largely underused.
blocks.zh:
然而,现有的有指导意义的个性化方法就如何在一代人中实现这些要求提供了有限的指导。
PlanPers(Salemi and Zamani, 2025)培训一个单独的计划员,以预测相关主题方面和条件解答所产生计划中的生成,但robridge监督以计划员而不是发电机为目标,规划错误可能影响最终响应.
IAP(Amirizaniani et al., 2026)转而将侧面覆盖转换为悬赏,并通过强化学习来优化,但这样的奖励很少,只能提供有限的反馈,说明什么象征性的决定有助于满足个别方面.
因此,现有方法只能通过粗糙的监管来利用用户特有的内容丰富的方面,而其获得精细的象征性指导的潜力则在很大程度上未得到充分利用。

blocks.en:
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a natural way to bridge this gap: a rubric-informed teacher can provide next-token supervision along the student’s own generation trajectories, allowing a rubric-free student to learn from guidance unavailable at inference time ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
Motivated by this, we propose GRASP , a Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation framework for LLM personalization.
Specifically, GRASP initializes a trainable rubric-free student, while the same frozen model conditioned on the user-specific rubric aspects serves as the teacher.
For responses sampled from the student, both models predict the next token at each student-generated prefix.
The student minimizes the forward KL divergence between the teacher’s and its own next-token distributions, receiving dense, rubric-conditioned supervision at the generation states it actually encounters.
By restricting rubric access to the teacher during training, GRASP distills this privileged guidance into the student, enabling personalized generation without rubrics at inference time.
In this way, GRASP translates user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained token-level learning signals, enabling substantially finer credit assignment throughout generation.
blocks.zh:
政策上的自我消化(OPSD)提供了弥补这一差距的自然途径:一个有名词的教师可以沿着学生自己一代人的轨迹提供近代监督,让无名词的学生能够学习推论时得不到的指导(Zhao等人,2026年)。
以此为动力,我们提出巨猿生存方案,作为LLM个性化的Rubric-Aware On-Political Self-dispiration框架。
具体地说,GRASP初始化了一个可培训的无标点符号的学生,而以用户专用标点符号为条件的同一冷冻模型则担任教师.
对于从学生中抽取的答复,两个模型都预测每个学生产生的前缀的下一个符号.
学生将老师与自己近亲分配之间的前向KL差异最小化,
巨猿生存方案通过限制教师在培训期间接触教师的机会,将这种特殊指导分解到学生身上,使学生能够在推论时不带数字的个性化一代。
通过这种方式,巨猿生存方案将用户特有的标题方面转化为精细的符号级学习信号,使整个世代的信用分配更加精细。

blocks.en:
Taking a step further, even when conditioned on the target rubric aspects, the teacher may still generate signals that inadequately reflect or cover them.
Distilling such underperforming teacher signals can steer the student in the wrong direction, and these uninformative rollouts also reduce training efficiency.
To address this, we introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which validates each teacher output against the target rubrics and retains only those where the rubric-informed teacher demonstrably provides adequate aspect coverage.
RTV therefore improves both the reliability of distillation and sample efficiency by focusing learning on informative teacher signals.
blocks.zh:
更进一步,即使以目标标的方面为条件,教师仍可能生成反映或覆盖不充分的信号。
抖动这种表现不佳的教师信号可以引导学生向错误的方向前进,这些无信息化的推出也降低了培训效率.
为了解决这一问题,我们引入了基于Rubric的教师验证法(RTV),它对照目标标题验证每个教师产出,并只保留那些明显由名义上知情的教师提供足够面面面覆盖的内容。
因此,RTV通过将学习重点放在信息化的教师信号上,提高了蒸馏的可靠性和样本效率.

blocks.en:
We evaluate GRASP on LaMP-QA ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) , a large-scale PQA benchmark spanning three diverse domains.
Experimental results show that GRASP achieves state-of-the-art performance across different backbone models.
blocks.zh:
我们评价LAMP-QA上的巨猿生存方案(Salemi和Zamani,2025年),这是一个涵盖三个不同领域的大规模PQA基准。
实验结果显示,巨猿生存方案在不同骨干模型之间实现了最先进的性能。

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We identify a key limitation of existing rubric-guided personalization approaches: they provide limited guidance on how to realize user-specific rubric aspects during generation, leaving the potential of rubrics for fine-grained, token-level supervision largely underused. • To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to bring on-policy self-distillation to personalization, where a rubric-informed teacher transfers the guidance of user-specific rubric aspects to the student through token-level supervision. • We propose GRASP, a Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation framework for personalization, equipped with Rubric-based Teacher Validation that filters unreliable teacher signals to improve supervision quality and training efficiency. • Extensive experiments on personalized question answering using LaMP-QA across multiple backbones demonstrate that GRASP consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
LLM Personalization. Personalization is essential for LLMs to serve each individual’s distinct needs ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026b ; Luo et al., 2026 ) , and has been pursued through training-free conditioning ( Richardson et al., 2023 ; Qiu et al., 2025b ) , supervised fine-tuning ( Tan et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and reinforcement learning ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Amirizaniani et al., 2026 ) .
Most of these efforts, however, target personalized content generation, where the model writes reviews, emails, or articles on a user’s behalf ( Kumar et al., 2024 ; Zhuang et al., 2024 ; Qiu et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , while far less attention has been paid to the case where users seek information rather than delegate writing: in personalized question answering, the model must infer what a user needs to know rather than imitate how they write.
LaMP-QA ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) was introduced as a benchmark for this setting, pairing each question with a user profile and a set of user-specific rubric aspects that specify the information needs a satisfactory answer should address.
Building on it, IAP ( Amirizaniani et al., 2026 ) prompts the model to articulate the latent intent behind a question before answering and optimizes the resulting trajectories with RL against a reward derived from these aspects, while VAC ( Salemi and Zamani, 2026 ) replaces such scalar rewards with natural language critiques from a learned feedback model and fine-tunes the policy on the revised responses.
Across these paradigms, on-policy distillation remains unexplored for personalization, and our work aims to fill this gap.
blocks.zh:
LLM 个性化. 个性化对于LLMS满足每个人的特殊需求至关重要(Zhang等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年;Xu等人,2025年;Xu等人,2026年b;Luo等人,2026年b),并通过免费培训(Richardson等人,2023年;Quu等人,2025年b),监督微调(Tan等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2025年),以及强化学习(Zhang等人,2025年;Amirizaniani等人,2026年).
然而,这些努力大多针对个性化的内容生成,即模型代表用户撰写评论、电子邮件或文章(Kumar等人,2024年;Zhuang等人,2000年)。 2024; 邱等人, 2025a; 王等人, 2025 ), 虽然对用户寻求信息而非委托书写的情况关注少得多: 在个性化的问题回答中,模型必须推断用户需要知道什么而不是模仿他们如何书写.
LaMP-QA(Salemi和Zamani,2025年)是这个设置的基准,将每个问题配以用户简介和一套用户特有的说明需要信息的内容,应该解决一个令人满意的答案。
在此基础上,IAP(Amirizaniani et al., 2026)促使该模式在回答一个问题背后的潜在意图之前,先用RL回答并优化由此产生的轨迹,而不是从这些方面得到的奖励,而VAC(Salemi和Zamani, 2026)则用学习到的反馈模型的自然语言批评来取代这种分级奖励,并微调对订正答复的政策。
在这些范式中,关于政策的提炼仍未为个性化加以探讨,我们的工作旨在填补这一空白。

blocks.en:
On-Policy Self-Distillation. On-policy distillation (OPD) ( Lu, 2025 ) is a post-training paradigm that trains a student on trajectories sampled from its own policy, querying a teacher at each visited state for dense token-level supervision ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ; Song and Zheng, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ) .
Recent studies have extensively explored its optimization strategies and applications, demonstrating strong potential across diverse reasoning and generation tasks ( Jin et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ) .
Within this paradigm, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) instantiates the teacher and student from a single model conditioned on different contexts: only the teacher observes privileged information that is unavailable at deployment ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
Existing work has explored diverse forms of such context, including verified reasoning traces ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , environment feedback ( Zhang et al., 2026d ) , and evidence-guided context ( Lazaridis et al., 2026 ) .
Such contexts are externally verifiable or globally fixed; however, personalized QA provides user-specific rubric aspects: per-question semantic specifications.
To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to bring OPSD to LLM personalization.
blocks.zh:
政策上的自我分裂。 政策蒸馏(OPD)(Lu, 2025年)是一个培训后范式,它训练一名学生学习从自己政策中抽查的轨迹,向每个受访州的一位教师询问密集的符号级监督(Agarwal等人,2024年;Song and Zheng,2026年;Li等人,2026年b).
最近的研究广泛探索了它的优化策略和应用,显示出跨越各种推理和生成任务的强大潜力(Jin等人,2026年;Fang等人,2026年;Li等人,2026a年)。
在这一范式中,政策上的自我消化(OPSD)(Zhao等人,2026年)从一个以不同情况为条件的单一模式中对教师和学生进行即审即决:只有教师观察到部署时无法获得的特权信息(Wang等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年b); 张等, 2026a.).
现有工作探索了这种背景的不同形式,包括经核实的推理痕迹(赵等人,2026年),环境反馈(张等人,2026年d),以及证据指导的背景(拉扎里迪斯等人,2026年).
这种背景是外部可核查的或全球固定的;然而,个性化的QA提供了用户特有的标题方面:每问题语义规格.
就我们所知,我们是第一个将OPSD引入LLM个性化的人.

blocks.en:
Personalized question answering requires generating responses that cover the aspects that matter to each individual user.
To this end, we propose GRASP , a new training paradigm that brings on-policy self-distillation to PQA.
At its core, Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation treats user-specific rubric aspects as privileged information and transfers their guidance to the student through dense token-level supervision.
To improve teacher reliability and training efficiency, we further introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation, which retains only verified teacher signals for distillation.
Figure 1 provides an overview of GRASP.
Next, we elaborate these components in detail.

为此,我们提出“巨猿生存方案”,这是一种新的培训模式,将政策自我消化纳入“质量评估”。
作为核心,Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation将用户特有的标题方面视为特权信息,并通过密集的符号级监督将其指导转移给学生.
为了提高教师的可靠性和培训效率,我们进一步采用了基于Rubric的教师验证法,它只保留经核实的教师信号用于蒸馏.

blocks.en:
Although the rubric-informed teacher has access to the target aspects, privileged information alone does not guarantee reliable supervision.
The teacher may still overlook or insufficiently address some aspects when generating a response.
Since the rubric-aware self-distillation framework directly transfers the teacher’s token distributions to the student, such failures may introduce misleading supervision.
To address this, we introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which evaluates the teacher’s ability to utilize the provided rubric aspects and excludes unreliable instances before distillation.

blocks.en:
Datasets & Evaluation. We experiment on LaMP-QA ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) , a comprehensive benchmark for personalized long-form question answering covering three main categories: Arts & Entertainment (A&E), Lifestyle & Personal Development (L&PD), and Society & Culture (S&C).
Each instance pairs a question x u x_{u} with a user profile P u P_{u} containing previously asked questions and a set of personalized rubric aspects E x u E_{x_{u}} .

Implementation Details. Following the official LaMP-QA ( Salemi and Zamani, 2025 ) protocol, both the student and teacher receive the top- 10 10 user-profile entries ranked by Contriever ( Izacard et al., 2022 ) , while only the teacher additionally observes the target rubric aspects.

We train GRASP for 1 epoch and select the checkpoint with the highest score on the validation set for testing.

blocks.en:
Table 1: Performance comparison between the baselines and GRASP across four backbones of varying scale on LaMP-QA.
The best results are highlighted in bold , and the second-best results are underlined .
Higher values indicate better performance.

表1:LAMP-QA四个不同规模主干线的基线和巨猿生存方案的业绩比较。

blocks.en:
We begin by evaluating the overall performance of all compared methods on LaMP-QA.
Experimental results are presented in Table 1 , from which we draw the following observations: • User profiles provide valuable signals for personalized question answering. Across the four backbones, incorporating user profiles generally improves performance over the Non-Perso setting.
This demonstrates that historical user information provides useful signals for understanding user-specific preferences and information needs. • Directly enhancing model capability yields suboptimal personalization gains. SFT yields consistent but modest gains over RAG, as its silver labels are generated by the backbone itself and are therefore constrained by its existing personalization capability.
This limits the additional user-specific guidance that SFT can provide. • Rubric aspects offer stronger supervision, yet coarse-grained utilization limits their potential. PlanPers generally achieves substantial gains, while IAP performs strongly on certain backbones but remains unstable across others.
Both methods leverage rubric aspects only at a coarse granularity, either as supervision for planner training or as scalar rewards, highlighting the need for finer-grained supervision to better exploit rubric information. • GRASP consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. GRASP consistently obtains the highest average score on all four backbones with diverse model families and scales.
For instance, on the Gemma2-9B backbone, GRASP achieves an average relative improvement of 14 14 % over the strongest baseline.
These results highlight the effectiveness of our rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework and underscore the importance of leveraging user-specific rubric aspects as fine-grained, token-level supervision.

blocks.en: 5.3 Framework Analyses
blocks.zh: 5.3 框架分析

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct additional experiments to further study the design and effectiveness of our proposed GRASP.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行了更多的实验,以进一步研究我们拟议的巨猿生存方案的设计及其效力。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Effect of RTV and its threshold τ \tau .
blocks.zh: 图2:RTV及其阈值的影响\ tau。

blocks.en:
RTV Ablation and Threshold Analysis. We study the effect of our introduced RTV and its threshold τ \tau .
Here, τ = 0 \tau=0 denotes vanilla OPSD without teacher validation, while larger values impose stricter requirements on teacher reliability.
We evaluate τ ∈ { 0 , 0.2 , 0.5 , 0.8 , 1.0 } \tau\in\{0,0.2,0.5,0.8,1.0\} on Gemma2-9B and Qwen2.5-7B , and compare τ = 0 \tau=0 and τ = 1 \tau=1 on Qwen2.5-14B and Qwen3-4B , with all other settings unchanged.
blocks.zh:
RTV 校对与阈值分析. 我们研究我们引进的RTV及其阈值的效果。
这里,\\ tau=0表示香草OPSD没有教师验证,而更大的值对教师的可靠性提出了更严格的要求.
我们在Gemma2-9B和Quen2.5-7B上评价 {0, 0, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0}\tau\in, 0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, 1.0}, 比较\\ 0\ tau=0和\ tau=1 在Quen2.5-14B和Quen3-4B上,所有其他设置不变.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 2 , RTV with τ = 1 \tau=1 consistently improves performance across all four backbones.
For Gemma2-9B and Qwen2.5-7B , lower thresholds yield limited and non-monotonic gains, while stricter validation generally leads to better performance.
This suggests that lenient validation may retain unreliable teacher signals with incomplete rubric coverage, whereas requiring full coverage provides more reliable supervision for distillation.
Overall, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of RTV and support τ = 1 \tau=1 as our default setting.
We provide a more detailed analysis of RTV in Appendix D.1 .
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,使用 =1\tau=1的RTV持续改善所有四个骨干部门的业绩。
对于Gemma2-9B和Quen2.5-7B来说,较低的阈值收益有限且非模拟收益,而更严格的验证一般会导致更好的性能.
这表明,宽大验证可能保留不可靠的教师信号,没有完全覆盖,而要求全覆盖则为蒸馏提供了更可靠的监督。
总的来说,这些结果证明了RTV的有效性,支持\\\ tau=1作为我们的默认设置.
我们对附录D.1中的RTV作了更详细的分析。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Teacher capability and distillation effectiveness.
blocks.zh: 图3:教师能力和蒸馏效果。

blocks.en:
Teacher Capability and Distillation Effectiveness. To investigate whether larger models can further improve personalization, we compare each backbone with its larger counterpart specified in Appendix C under both standard RAG and our self-distillation framework.
Under RAG, we directly compare the two model sizes to assess the benefit of increased model capacity.
For GRASP, we keep the backbone as the student and use either itself or its larger counterpart as the rubric-informed teacher.
We report the macro-average score across the three categories.
blocks.zh:
教师能力与消沉效果. 为了调查更大的模型是否能够进一步改善个性化,我们比较了每个主干与附录C在标准RAG和我们的自我消化框架下所指定的较大对等.
在RAG下,我们直接比较两个模型大小,以评估增加模型容量的好处.
对巨猿生存方案来说,我们保留作为学生的骨干,并使用自身或更大的对应方作为鲁博知识教师.
我们报告这三类的宏观平均得分。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 3 , simply scaling up the model under RAG yields inconsistent gains and can even degrade performance.
Similarly, using a larger teacher in GRASP provides no clear advantage over self-distillation.
These results suggest that increased model or teacher capacity alone is not the key to effective PQA.
Instead, the gains primarily come from leveraging user-specific rubric aspects and effectively transferring their guidance to the student, further supporting the core design of GRASP.
blocks.zh:
如图3所示,只要在RAG下扩大模型就会产生不一致的收益,甚至可以降低性能.
同样,在巨猿生存方案中使用一个较大的教师并不能比自我消化有明显的优势。
这些结果表明,单靠提高模式或教师能力不能成为有效的质量保证的关键。
相反,收益主要来自利用用户特有的标题方面,并有效地向学生转移指导,进一步支持巨猿生存方案的核心设计。

blocks.en:
Effect of User-Specific Rubric Alignment. To examine whether the effectiveness of GRASP arises from the question-specific information encoded in the user-specific rubric aspects, rather than simply from additional teacher context, we construct a shuffled-rubric variant of GRASP.
Specifically, we keep the question and user profile unchanged while randomly shuffling rubric sets across training instances.
This preserves the overall distribution of rubric aspects but breaks their instance-level alignment with the corresponding question and user profile.
All other settings remain unchanged.
blocks.zh:
用户特定Rubric对齐的效果。 为了审查巨猿生存方案的有效性是否来自用户特定标题中编码的特定问题信息,而不是仅仅来自额外的教师背景,我们构建了巨猿生存方案的一个变体。
具体地说,我们不改变问题和用户配置,而随机打乱各种培训组合。
这保留了标题方面的总体分布,但打破了实例级别与相应问题和用户配置的一致.
所有其他设置保持不变。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 2 , shuffled rubrics lead to a substantial performance drop.
This result demonstrates that the benefit of rubric-aware self-distillation stems not from exposing the teacher to arbitrary additional context, but from the question-specific semantic targets encoded in the rubric aspects that guide the student toward the current user’s information needs.
Misaligned rubrics steer the teacher toward irrelevant continuations, making the transferred token-level preferences ineffective for personalization and highlighting the importance of accurate user–question–rubric alignment.
blocks.zh:
如表2所示,洗牌导致业绩大幅下降。
这一结果表明,Rumic-aware自我消化的好处不在于使教师面临任意的附加背景,而在于在Rumic方面编码的针对特定问题的语义目标,引导学生了解当前用户的信息需求。
错误的标语引导老师走向无关紧要的续作,使得转移的符号级偏好对于个性化无效,并凸显了准确的用户-问题-rubric校对的重要性.

blocks.en: Table 2: Effect of user-specific rubric alignment under GRASP. Shuffled uses rubrics from other questions, while Matched uses the corresponding rubrics.
blocks.zh: 表2:巨猿生存方案下用户专用标题对齐的效果。 shuffled使用来自其他问题的路标,而Matched则使用相应的路标.

blocks.en:
Rubric-Induced Token Distribution Shifts. We next examine whether the gains of GRASP arise from its intended mechanism: transferring the token-level effect of privileged rubric information into a rubric-free student.
We conduct this analysis on Qwen2.5-7B using 90 90 held-out responses.
Specifically, for each question and user profile, we first sample a response from the student before training.
At every answer position, we then feed the same sampled prefix to three models: the student before training, the student after training, and the rubric-conditioned teacher.
This matched-prefix setup ensures that the observed differences arise from changes in the next-token distribution rather than from the models generating different preceding text.
blocks.zh:
Rubric - 诱导的托肯发行移动. 我们接下来审查巨猿生存方案的收益是否来自其预期机制:将特权名称信息的象征性效应转移到无名学生身上。
我们在Quen2.5-7B上利用90个搁置的答复进行这一分析。
具体地说,对于每个问题和用户简介,我们首先抽取学生在训练前的答复.
在每一个答题位置上,我们都会给三个模型提供相同的样本前缀:培训前的学生,培训后的学生,以及标语条件的教师.
这种匹配的前缀设置可以确保观察到的差异来自邻接字位分布的变化,而不是来自产生不同前文本的模型.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 (a) compares rubric-induced and training-induced probability shifts for each observed token.
The two shifts agree in direction for 79.2 % 79.2\% of 14,216 tokens, with a correlation of r = 0.71 r=0.71 , indicating that GRASP learns to promote rubric-favored tokens and suppress rubric-disfavored ones.
Figure 4 (b) extends this analysis to the full vocabulary.
The response-level forward KL between teacher and student decreases from 1.101 1.101 to 0.444 0.444 on average after training, with all 90 responses moving closer to the rubric-conditioned teacher.
Figure 4 (c) shows a representative example:
after the prefix “Given your,” training raises the probability of the observed token “cat” from 4.2 × 10 − 5 4.2\times 10^{-5} to 0.87 0.87 , close to the teacher probability of 0.99 0.99 , while generic alternatives are suppressed.
Together, these results suggest that GRASP transfers the rubric’s steering effect into the student itself: training reshapes its token distributions toward those induced by rubric conditioning, enabling rubric-guided generation even when the rubric is absent at inference time.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduced GRASP, a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for personalized question answering.
GRASP transforms user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained, token-level supervision by aligning a rubric-free student with a frozen rubric-informed teacher along student-generated trajectories.
We further proposed Rubric-based Teacher Validation to improve the reliability of teacher guidance.
Experiments on LaMP-QA across four diverse backbones show that GRASP consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, while further analyses confirm the importance of user-specific rubric aspects and reliable supervision.
Overall, our findings demonstrate the value of fine-grained distributional supervision for personalization.
To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to introduce on-policy self-distillation as a post-training approach to personalization, offering a new paradigm for adapting language models to individual users.

在这项工作中,我们介绍了巨猿生存方案,这是一个关于政策自我消化的框架,用于个性化回答问题。
GRASP将用户特有的路标方面转换为精细的,符号级的监管,将无路标的学生与冻结的路标知情教师沿着学生生成的轨迹对齐.
我们进一步提出了基于Rubric的教师验证,以提高教师指导的可靠性.
关于LAMP-QA的实验涉及四个不同的骨干网,这些实验表明,巨猿生存方案一贯取得最先进的业绩,而进一步的分析则证实了用户特有的标题和可靠监督的重要性。
总的来说,我们的调查结果表明,精细的分销监督对于个性化很有价值。

• Non-Perso :
This baseline directly applies the unmodified backbone to the current question without providing any user-profile information.
It therefore measures the performance of general question answering in the absence of personalization. • RAG :
This baseline augments the current question with the top- 10 10 entries retrieved from the user profile and feeds them to the unmodified backbone for response generation.
It measures the personalization gains achieved by directly incorporating relevant user history as additional context. • SFT :
We construct silver-labeled training data through best-of-five rejection sampling.
For each training instance, the corresponding backbone generates five candidate responses conditioned on the question and retrieved user profile.
We evaluate each candidate against the target rubric aspects, following the same per-aspect scoring procedure used for test-set evaluation, and retain the candidate with the highest average score.
The backbone is then fine-tuned on the resulting question–profile–response pairs. • PlanPers :
We follow the two-stage PlanPers pipeline.
First, a planner initialized from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct is fine-tuned with LoRA to predict the rubric aspect titles from the question and retrieved user profile.
At inference time, the planner first predicts a set of relevant aspects for each question.
The corresponding frozen backbone then generates the final response conditioned on the question, retrieved user profile, and predicted aspects. • IAP :
We implement IAP by prompting the policy to first articulate the inferred user intent and then generate the final personalized response.
The policy is optimized with DAPO.
Following the original formulation, its reward combines rubric-based personalization quality, a contrastive term relative to an intent-free reference response, and a penalty on excessively long intent reasoning.

blocks.en: D.1 RTV Ablation and Threshold Analysis

blocks.en:
To understand why Gemma2-9B benefits more substantially from increasing the RTV threshold than the other backbones, we examine the distribution of teacher reliability scores across the training set.
Because RTV retains only instances satisfying s T ≥ τ s_{T}\geq\tau , the cumulative proportion below each threshold indicates how much potentially unreliable supervision is filtered out.

As shown in Figure 5 , Gemma2-9B exhibits a considerably heavier tail in the low- and intermediate-reliability regions.
Only 37 % 37\% of its training instances attain s T = 1 s_{T}=1 , compared with 57 % 57\% , 62 % 62\% , and 81 % 81\% for Qwen2.5-14B , Qwen2.5-7B , and Qwen3-4B , respectively.
Consequently, at a permissive threshold, many Gemma2-9B instances whose teacher responses only partially cover the target rubric aspects remain in the training set.
Raising τ \tau filters out a substantially larger proportion of such unreliable supervision, providing a distributional explanation for the more pronounced performance gains of Gemma2-9B at higher thresholds in Figure 2 .
By contrast, the reliability distributions of the other teachers are already more concentrated at s T = 1 s_{T}=1 ; increasing τ \tau therefore changes their retained training sets less substantially and leads to smaller incremental gains.
Overall, these results suggest that the effectiveness of RTV is closely related to the reliability distribution of the rubric-informed teacher, with stricter filtering being particularly beneficial when the distribution contains substantial low-score mass.

blocks.en: D.3 Effect of Rubric Completeness
blocks.zh: D.3 Rubric完整性的影响

blocks.en:
To investigate how the completeness of privileged rubric information affects distillation, we construct a single-aspect variant of GRASP.
For each training instance, the Single setting provides the rubric-informed teacher with only one aspect randomly sampled from E x u E_{x_{u}} , whereas the Full setting provides the complete set of target aspects.
All other training configurations remain unchanged.
This comparison allows us to determine whether an individual aspect is sufficient for effective supervision or whether the teacher benefits from jointly observing the user’s complete information needs.
blocks.zh:
为了调查特权标题信息的完整性如何影响蒸馏,我们构建了巨猿生存方案的一个单面变体。
对于每个培训实例,“单一设置”只向有标题的教师提供从Ex u E_{x_{u}} 随机抽取的一个方面,而“完整设置”则提供一整套目标方面。
所有其他培训配置保持不变。
这种比较使我们能够确定某一个方面是否足以进行有效监督,或者教师是否从联合观察用户的完整信息需求中受益。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 6 , using the complete rubric set consistently outperforms the single-aspect setting across all categories and backbones.
Providing only one aspect gives the teacher a partial view of the user’s information needs, resulting in incomplete supervision.
In contrast, the full rubric set captures complementary information across aspects and enables more comprehensive personalized guidance.
These results demonstrate that the effectiveness of GRASP depends not only on the availability of rubric information but also on its completeness.
blocks.zh:
如表6所示,使用完整的标题,所有类别和主干部分的单面设置都比单面设置的业绩一致。
仅提供一个方面使教师能部分了解用户的信息需求,导致监督不全。
与此相反,全套标题集收集了各方面的补充信息,并能够提供更全面的个性化指导。
这些结果表明,巨猿生存方案的有效性不仅取决于能否获得标题信息,还取决于其完整性。

blocks.en: D.4 Training Dynamics
blocks.zh: D.4 培训动态

blocks.en:
Figure 6 tracks three training-time signals over the single epoch.
Together, they reveal rapid convergence: the forward KL decreases sharply, the teacher–student top-1 agreement increases, and the gradient norm drops by approximately one order of magnitude.
Most of these changes occur within the first 20 20 - 30 % 30\% of training, after which all three curves gradually stabilize.
These trends indicate stable optimization toward the rubric-informed teacher distributions across different backbones.

这些变化大多发生在培训的前20个20-30%30QQ之内,之后所有三个曲线都逐渐稳定下来.
这些趋势表明,在不同骨干中,教师的分布将稳定优化。
